name: Unity C# Stackable Inventory Container
description: Data-driven Unity C# inventory system using ScriptableObject item definitions, stack merging, slot capacity limits, and change events.

preview.caption: Unity C# ScriptableObject + container component — inspect source tabs and attach InventoryContainer to a player GameObject.
architecture: InventoryContainer.TryAdd(item, count) -> merge existing stacks -> allocate free slots
preview.projectRef: Copy into Assets/Scripts/Inventory/ inside a Unity project.

install: Copy ItemDefinition.cs and InventoryContainer.cs into Assets/Scripts/Inventory/ in your Unity project.
usage: Create item assets via Right-Click -> Create -> Otter Library -> Item Definition, attach InventoryContainer to a GameObject, and call TryAdd / TryConsume.

verification.label: C# Harness Tested (Unity Stubs)
verification.details: Compiled and behaviorally tested under .NET via scripts/validate-components.mjs using minimal UnityEngine stubs (stack merging, capacity overflow, consumption, change events). Unity Editor Inspector serialization requires Unity Editor.
